summary: Tested all 4 new features end-to-end (backend + frontend). 12/12 backend pytest cases pass (GitHub OAuth demo endpoints, social-connect provider validation, admin CSV export, admin/github-profiles). Frontend UI verified via Playwright: Success Stories marquee with 8 story cards, dual provider Verified Identity rows, GitHub demo modal + verification + verified badge, skill popup CTA prefilling lead form with 'ROLE — PROJECT' text, admin dashboard with 4 tab cards including new GitHub tab, CSV download (ashtor_leads.csv), and EN/ES language toggle (ES shows 'Conectar GitHub' and 'Misiones reales. Impacto medible.').
critical_code_review_comments: Note (informational only, not a bug): review mentioned 'admin-tab-connections' testid but Admin.jsx only exposes tabs [leads, linkedin, verified, github]. All 4 tab cards render as expected; no missing card.
server.py exceeds 700 lines (869 lines) — consider splitting into routers (auth, admin, social, github, leads) for maintainability.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 social_connections rows via /api/social-connect during tests (TEST_GH User github, TEST_LI User linkedin). Leads count remained at 3 seeded rows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_new_features.py loads REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env via python-dotenv (pytest env doesn't inherit it). Use `pytest backend/tests/test_new_features.py -o addopts=''` to bypass xdist which isn't installed in the workers config. GitHub OAuth demo-mode is active (GITHUB_CLIENT_ID empty); real OAuth path not tested. LinkedIn button opens real linkedin.com — do not complete. Skill popups require real mouse-move (not element.hover) because Lenis + fixed navbar can intercept; use page.mouse.move to bounding_box center.
